description: Διεύθυνση Πληροφορικής και Επικοινωνιών: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Διεύθυνση Πληροφορικής και Επικοινωνιών. Coverage: Διεύθυνση Πληροφορικής και Επικοινωνιών. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Χάρτης Οδικού Δικτύου Φοινικοδάσους Πρέβελης; Χάρτης Οδικού Δικτύου Πρινοδάσους Ρούβα; Οδικό δίκτυο Κρήτης. Formats seen: ESRI REST, PDF, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
